title: Technical Pro WALL710 Wall Mount Bluetooth Speaker with LED (Black)

comparisons.notes: Exact match: model WALL710-B, black, single speaker, UPC 810172850712; store shows $65.00 and available.

writeup: Technical Pro's WALL710 wall-mount Bluetooth speaker in black is $26.99 new on Woot. Technical Pro sells the same model (WALL710-B) on its own site for $65, so this is 58% less. It has Bluetooth 5.4, seven LED lighting modes, and two can be paired for stereo. Woot showed only 1 left, limit 3 per customer.
